era.title: Post-Biological Civilization
era.subtitle: Intelligence transcends biology, bodies, and physical limitations
era.description: This era marks the rise of post-biological civilization, where consciousness, identity, and existence become increasingly independent of physical bodies. Digital minds, synthetic bodies, shared thought spaces, programmable matter, wormhole gateways, and reality engineering transform humanity into many forms of intelligence.
